title: Gudbrand i lien
world: Old rural Norway, long ago, in a deep mountain valley in the week before Christmas. Gudbrand's small farm sits high up on a steep hillside: a low log cottage and a little cowshed. A narrow path zigzags down past the Neighbour's farm to a small market town by a frozen river, along a snowy road lined with birches and sheaves of oats on poles. Gudbrand and his wife have three small children: a boy of about eight with short black hair and a green jumper, a girl of about six with two stubby fair plaits and a red dress, and a chubby toddler in a long white shirt. The animals: a black cow with a white face, a sandy-yellow fjord horse with a striped pale mane, a fat pink pig, a white nanny goat, a woolly white sheep, a big white goose and a cinnamon-brown rooster.
palette: The week before Christmas in clear, frosty weather: deep snow on the steep hillside, the fields and the turf roofs, short days of pale lemon-yellow sunshine with long blue shadows, and a pink glow when the sun goes down. Then a clear, deep-indigo night full of stars, with every small window glowing candle-yellow. Inside the cottage: warm firelight, straw ornaments and red-and-white cloths. Accents: the Wife's cornflower-blue apron and bright red rowan berries.

cast.name: Gudbrand
cast.description: En godhjertet bonde som bytter seg hjem fra byen, dyr for dyr, og holder seg rolig selv når alt går annerledes enn planlagt.
cast.look: A short, round, easy-going old farmer of about seventy with a round belly, a shiny bald head, fluffy white side-whiskers from his ears down to his jaw, a clean-shaven chin, a big pink nose, small merry blue eyes and a calm, contented smile. He wears a soft dark-green felt hat with a narrow brim, a thick knitted jacket with a black-and-white snowflake pattern and pewter clasps, a red knitted scarf, brown breeches, grey wool stockings and heavy boots, and always has a short curved wooden pipe.
cast.portrait: Background: the snowy hillside path with the valley far below.

cast.name: Kona
cast.description: Gudbrands blide kone, som ser noe bra i alt han gjør og tar imot ham med latter og varme når han kommer hjem.
cast.look: A plump, cheerful farm wife of about sixty-five, a little shorter than Gudbrand, with a round, beaming face, rosy cheeks, a broad, freckled nose, merry hazel eyes that crinkle when she laughs, and grey hair pinned up in a neat bun. She wears a long rose-red wool dress with a white linen collar and rolled-up sleeves, a bright cornflower-blue apron with a big bow at the back, and a cream knitted shawl round her shoulders.
cast.portrait: Background: the warm, firelit cottage room.

cast.name: Naboen
cast.description: En nysgjerrig nabo som ikke tror at kona kan være så snill, og som lytter ved døra for å finne det ut.
cast.look: A nosy, pot-bellied farmer of about fifty with a round, clean-shaven face, a long, pointed, twitchy nose, narrow doubtful eyes with one eyebrow always raised, big pink ears that stick straight out and short, spiky ginger hair. He wears a thick, knee-length sheepskin coat with the fleece showing at the collar and cuffs, a round brown fur hat with its ear flaps tied up on top, brown mittens and tall grey felt boots.
cast.portrait: Background: a snowy farmyard under a starry sky.

places.name: the Hillside Farm
places.look: A tiny farm high on a steep, snowy hillside: a low, dark-brown log cottage with a thick, snow-covered turf roof, a stone chimney, two small four-paned windows and a sturdy plank door painted dusky blue, with a little cowshed beside it. A birch and a rowan tree with red berries stand in the yard next to a sheaf of oats on a tall pole, and a narrow path zigzags steeply down towards the valley far below.

places.name: the Cottage Room
places.look: A snug, low-ceilinged log room with honey-brown timber walls. In one corner a whitewashed stone fireplace holds a crackling fire and a black iron pot. A long, scrubbed plank table with two benches stands under a small four-paned window with frost on the glass. There is a tall cupboard painted with red-and-blue rosemaling, a shelf of wooden bowls, straw ornaments hanging from the beams, pegs with coats and hats, and a dusky-blue plank door with an iron latch.

cover.prompt: Gudbrand sets off down the steep, snowy path from the Hillside Farm, leading the black cow with the white face on a rope and looking back over his shoulder with a cheerful wave, his pipe in the corner of his mouth. Up at the dusky-blue cottage door, the Wife waves him off with a big smile, the three children crowding round her skirts. Far below, the roofs of the little town lie in the valley. Crisp, sunny morning with long blue shadows.
cover.caption: Gudbrand tar kua i tauet og går til byen.
cover.alt: Gudbrand går nedover en bratt, snødekt sti med ei svart ku i et tau og vinker. Oppe ved den lille stua vinker kona og de tre ungene. Langt nede i dalen ligger byen.

illustrations.anchor: Kona hans var den blideste i hele bygda.
illustrations.prompt: Morning in the Cottage Room. By the fireplace, Gudbrand holds up the black iron pot with both hands, and a thin curl of grey smoke rises from the burnt porridge inside; he looks sheepish and apologetic. The Wife leans over the pot with her eyes closed and a blissful smile, sniffing the smoke as if it were the finest dish in the world, a wooden spoon raised in one hand. Pale winter light comes through the frosty window.
illustrations.caption: Brente Gudbrand grøten, sa kona: «Mmm! Røkt grøt!»
illustrations.alt: Gudbrand holder fram en svart gryte med brent grøt som ryker. Kona bøyer seg over gryta med lukkede øyne og smiler, som om det luktet deilig.

illustrations.anchor: Gudbrand så på kua og på hesten.
illustrations.prompt: A wide view of the snowy country road between birches and fences, with the little town far behind. Gudbrand hands the rope of his black cow with the white face to a tall stranger in a long grey coat and a fur hat, and happily takes the reins of the stranger's big, strong, sandy-yellow fjord horse in return. Gudbrand pats the horse's neck, very pleased with himself, while the cow looks back at him over her shoulder. Bright, low winter sun.
illustrations.caption: En hest er bedre enn ei ku, tenkte Gudbrand.
illustrations.alt: På en snødekt vei gir Gudbrand kua til en høy, fremmed mann og tar imot tøylene til en stor, lys hest. Gudbrand klapper hesten og ser fornøyd ut.

illustrations.anchor: Så solgte han hanen for litt småmynt og kjøpte brød og pølse.
illustrations.prompt: Late afternoon on the snowy roadside. Gudbrand sits contentedly on a big stone with his hat pushed back, a long sausage in one hand and a round loaf of bread in the other, his cheeks full and his eyes closed with pleasure. A little way down the road behind him, a farm boy in a blue knitted cap walks off with the cinnamon-brown rooster tucked under his arm. The low sun turns the snow pink and gold, with long blue shadows.
illustrations.caption: Det er bedre med mat i magen enn en hane under armen!
illustrations.alt: Gudbrand sitter på en stein ved veien og spiser pølse og brød med lukkede øyne. Litt bortenfor går en gutt av sted med hanen under armen.

illustrations.anchor: Da stjernene kom fram, gikk de sammen hjem til Gudbrand.
illustrations.prompt: Night at the Hillside Farm under a sky full of stars. Gudbrand walks calmly up to the dusky-blue cottage door, where warm candle-yellow light glows in the small windows. Behind him, the Neighbour tiptoes through the deep snow to the log wall right beside the door, bent over, with one mitten cupped behind his big ear and a sly, eager look on his face. A wide view, deep-indigo sky, snow glittering in the starlight.
illustrations.caption: Naboen lister seg bort til veggen og holder hånda bak øret.
illustrations.alt: Det er stjerneklar natt. Gudbrand går mot døra til den lille stua med lys i vinduene, mens naboen lister seg bort til veggen og holder hånda bak øret.

illustrations.prompt: A wide view of the Cottage Room at night, lit by the fire and a candle on the supper table. The Wife claps her hands with delight, beaming. The three children tumble off the bench and race each other towards the door, eager to put the goat in the shed. Just inside the door, Gudbrand stands wringing his hat in his hands, his bald head shining in the firelight, lifting one finger to stop them.
illustrations.caption: «Ei geit! Så flink du er! Unger, sett inn geita!»
illustrations.alt: Kona klapper i hendene av glede, og de tre ungene springer mot døra. Innenfor døra står Gudbrand og vrir hatten i hendene.

illustrations.anchor: Da lo kona, mildt og godt, og la hånda på armen hans.
illustrations.prompt: A close, warm view across the supper table in the Cottage Room, lit by a candle and the glow of the fire. Gudbrand sits with his hat on the table beside him and his pipe in his hand, peeking at the Wife with a hopeful, sheepish face. The Wife sits next to him, laughing warmly with her eyes crinkled shut, one hand resting gently on his arm. On the table: bowls of porridge, a round loaf and a jug of milk.
illustrations.caption: Da lo kona, mildt og godt, og la hånda på armen hans.
illustrations.alt: Gudbrand og kona sitter ved kveldsbordet i stua. Kona ler og legger hånda på armen hans, og Gudbrand kikker forsiktig bort på henne.

illustrations.anchor: «Kom inn og spis med oss, du også», sa kona.
illustrations.prompt: Seen from the snowy yard of the Hillside Farm on a starry night: the dusky-blue cottage door stands wide open and warm light pours out onto the snow. On the doorstep, the Neighbour, still bent over with one mitten cupped behind his ear, grins sheepishly. Gudbrand holds the door open, smiling broadly around his pipe. Inside, the Wife waves the Neighbour in towards the supper table, where the three children are already sitting.
illustrations.caption: «Kom inn og spis med oss, du også», sa kona.
illustrations.alt: Døra står åpen, og varmt lys strømmer ut i snøen. Naboen står bøyd med hånda bak øret og smiler flaut, mens Gudbrand holder døra og kona vinker ham inn til bordet.
